metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully moved the 3x3 number table on Slide 3 to the bottom. Chaining with a title rename hardens the task.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate slides, move shapes, edit title text in placeholders
metadata.explanation: Partial credit: 0.5 for table top >= 60% of slide height, 0.5 for slide 3 title == 'Film List'. Initial state fails both checks (table at top, title is 'Movie List'). [Fixed: renamed metric function from check_impress_slide3_bottom_and_title__80d9e8d7efd024cbc51991913269b5fb to impress_slide3_bottom_and_title__80d9e8d7efd024cbc51991913269b5fb to match evaluator.func reference]
fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed metric function from check_impress_slide3_bottom_and_title__80d9e8d7efd024cbc51991913269b5fb to impress_slide3_bottom_and_title__80d9e8d7efd024cbc51991913269b5fb — validator looks for the exact name from evaluator.func, without check_ prefix

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts table position using shape_type==19 (MSO TABLE) and returns table_top and slide_height needed for position check.
Getter correctly identifies the slide 3 title via placeholder_format.idx==0 (standard title placeholder), returning the title text.
Metric check 1 correctly verifies 'table at bottom' by comparing table_top >= slide_height * 0.6, a reasonable threshold for 'bottom of slide'.
Metric check 2 correctly verifies the title rename with exact string match to 'Film List'.
Partial credit structure (0.5 + 0.5) aligns with the two composed sub-goals in the instruction.
Negative-control resistance is good: initial state has table at top and title 'Movie List', so both checks fail on unmodified file.
The rule_validation failure ('metric function not found') is a structural deployment/path issue, not a semantic flaw in the evaluator logic itself.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Investigate the path resolution issue causing rule_validation to report 'metric function not found' — verify the tmp_funcs directory is registered correctly with the function loader.
Consider using a slightly more generous position threshold (e.g., 0.55) to avoid penalizing cases where the table bottom edge is at the slide bottom but table_top is just under 60%.
